name: spellout
description: Spell out your idea before AI builds it.

interface.shortDescription: 点几下，把想法说透，AI 再动手。
interface.longDescription: Adaptive inline choice cards, multi-round requirements interviews and scenario checks help users clarify goals, correct assumptions and confirm requirements before work begins.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SpellOut to understand my real requirements through questions and concrete scenarios before implementation.
